scope: Actual tile simulation, Session host/guest, snapshot and drag-controller cases. Browser and physical-device checks are separate.

results.name: 25 maps have 20 unique legal shared slots and distinct combo-ready hero starts
hero/building occupancy enforces N-H for solo and coop, including dead heroes
arbitrary coordinates, fractional positions, path and old move commands cannot bypass slots
successful relocation atomically frees the origin and preserves all combat timers and health
occupied, same-slot, foreign hero, wrong battle, stale and duplicate requests do not move twice
every prep phase permits relocation while combat, pause and death respect their own rules
all eight heroes remain anchored, cast and naturally revive on their reserved slot
Donguibogam revives on the same reserved tile without releasing capacity
new blade and spear attacks fly before impact; slow and star passive occur at impact
a launched weapon wave survives its caster relocating and dying before impact
a dead homing target cannot transfer a fourth-shot star or damage to a different enemy
heroes no longer block roads, while summoned soldiers still block and fight
Gang charge wave crosses targets once without moving the hero or damaging at cast
a linear blade wave pierces two enemies and never damages either twice
snapshot carries slots, reservations, results, cooldowns and all three new projectile kinds
two clients racing for a shared tile get one approval with independent wallets
hero drop and building construction race atomically and rejected construction costs nothing
post-send background/reconnect follows host approval and keeps request numbering
full sync settles queued drops before the guest resolves approval, with no simulation tick
drag controller commits only a threshold-crossing valid drop, never changes state on cancellation
room admission rejects missing/old rules and admits exactly matching clients
overlapping expanded tile targets resolve to the nearest centre and keyboard keeps its focused tile
pointer capture cannot drop onto a tile behind a HUD overlay
